text: Phase 11 duplicate audit removed mvpa-spatial SearchlightCenter/SearchlightWindow/SearchlightWindowSet after all repository consumers migrated. Retained wrappers are documented in the compatibility ledger: image and surface data facades delegate to locus; atlas.Region and spatial.VoxelRegion are deprecated aliases with next-breaking-release removal conditions; Zarr Geometry.Region is an out-of-scope chunk rectangle. MaskedField is no longer a case class and exposes primitive arrays only through defensive copies.
